title: Chevrolet Vega Engines by Year (1971–1977)
description: Every factory engine in the Chevrolet Vega by year, 1971–1977: the aluminum-block 2.3 four in one- and two-barrel form, and the twin-cam Cosworth Vega.
intro: The Vega was Chevrolet's subcompact from 1971 to 1977. Every Vega used a 2.3 four with an aluminum cylinder block, and the 1975–1976 Cosworth Vega used a twin-cam, fuel-injected version.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
Ratings are gross for 1971 and SAE net from 1972. The one-barrel engine was dropped after 1976, leaving the two-barrel as the only engine for 1977.
